observations: Position and Rotation are global physics components with placeholder sentinel values. In the 3D branch Rotation wraps a quaternion and multiplying a vector applies that rotation; conversion from GlobalTransform extracts its decomposed rotation. Parent hierarchy transforms are composed by the initialization hook; application world/local producer frames and native synchronization scheduling need independent inspection.

Initialization decides separately whether position and rotation are placeholders, derives defaults, composes parent transforms and may reparent an explicit physics pose into local Transform before filling placeholders from a previously computed global transform. For mixed explicit/placeholder values with a parent, examine exact configuration, hook order, later synchronization and supported application producers before deciding whether any inconsistency persists.

The 2D branch exposes sine and cosine and checks normalization in debug assertions; the 3D branch wraps a quaternion directly.
